items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: He and I, we were great pals. We hung out together

ctx.x: On the road, or in New York. He and I, we were great pals. We hung out together, and why I answered you so quick, I mean we've been accused of that for so many years, of being -- I was accused of being Fats' right-hand man, and one of those things. I think he liked me a lot too because I reminded him of his brother, Lawrence. Lawrence Waller, yeah, because he used to tell me that. Quite a lot. You sure remind me of my brother Lawrence. I don't see it.
You mean in appearance? Or personality?
